address: 4650 Donald Ross Rd., Ste. 100, West Palm Beach, FL, 33418, USA
bio: Amid lush greenery framing the entrance, this restaurant opens to a range of comfortable velvet seating in shades of green and mustard yellow, surrounded by subtle peacock motif artwork throughout the space, adding a touch of color and personality. The menu focuses on Indian cuisine, rooted in regional flavors. Lamb samosas with their savory filling of ground lamb and peas in a flaky pastry purse, well spiced with a gentle heat and served with a cilantro mint chutney, are the perfect starter. Then, move on to the Kerala curried beef short rib, fork tender and served with piping hot, fluffy basmati rice. For sides, try the paratha with tamarind and green mango chutneys. Both lean sweet but offer good depth, with the mango chutney delivering a pleasant touch of heat.
